change: Prepare signed surface fillet offsets from bounded closest normals to the other original UV pick, using existing conditioned source preparation. Native oracle uses those picks unless an explicit diagnostic side override is supplied. Reserve internal construction precision for fitted rail/loft normals without changing caller acceptance. Fix the C ABI probe to evaluate its actual stored endpoints.

sdk_comparison.scope: All sixteen recipes are executed without side overrides. Checks cover source purity, one valid owned output, bidirectional 81-point surface image membership, membership of all closest points on the other surface, closest distances and tight bounds at the caller epsilon. Literal closest-point coordinate differences remain diagnostics, including tangential discrepancies above epsilon. Full NURBS/topology/area protocols remain unnormalized and are compared separately; sampled geometry checks are not complete protocol parity or a global continuous error certificate. The original curved Extend=Yes extent mismatch remains unqualified.

old_executable.scope: Existing release binary retained before rebuilding the oracle for this change; the previous completed goal turn built and audited this executable.

independent_accuracy_diagnostic.scope: Controlled temporary native wrapper override reserves one sixteenth of caller accuracy after validating the original request. Same Rust query driver and public inputs; tightening only the projection solver does not remove the old construction error. This diagnoses one torus family, not global C1 accuracy.

closest_point_qualification.scope: Literal coordinate comparison failed in the full oracle. An independent metric torus projection shows this SDK answer differs tangentially by about 3.1e-8 while both sampled surface images agree below 5e-10. Fitted-normal effects and SDK query stopping are not distinguished. Original closest-point coordinates and raw audit failures remain unchanged. Geometry qualification uses bidirectional sampled membership, closest distances and bounds at the original 1e-8 epsilon; this does not claim literal closest-point coordinate parity.

native_fillet_matrix.scope: 56 full geometry and lifetime cases, ten invalid requests; original 1e-8 analytic radius/extent checks. Inputs and private parents die before export; exported definitions outlive the native result.

probe_failure.cause: Probe interpolated the last edge sample to 15.000000000000004 although the stored upper endpoint and active knot limit are 15.000000000000002. Native Parameter outside NURBS domain rejection is correct. Final probe uses the exact stored endpoints; no curve domain or acceptance tolerance changed.

sdk_capture.initial_postcapture_check: Initial expected-sides assertion was incorrect for a negative-X pick next to a bounded first-quadrant cylinder. Full SDK capture completed before this diagnostic assertion. Both original expected-sides hypothesis and failure log remain retained; qualification uses the bounded projection result.

basis_input_equivalence.method: Independent 80-digit Decimal Cox-de Boor power-polynomial expansion on every knot span. Compare all homogeneous coefficients for both V rows against the original degree-two chart. Sum absolute coefficient differences on [0,1], divide by the positive source weight lower bound, and bound Cartesian denominator perturbations using the target control hull. Bounds include decimal JSON coefficient rounding; tensor V blending preserves them.
basis_input_equivalence.scope: A complete same-parameter image equivalence bound for these finite JSON input recipes. It does not certify a general extension algorithm or output surfaces.

extension_followup.scope: 16 fresh SDK calls: 14 basis/chart recipes and two tolerance variants. Degree elevation preserves observed extension endpoints; knot insertion changes them despite complete same-parameter input polynomial bounds below 6.4e-14 in decimal JSON. The remote chart returns no fillet. Loose tolerance changes shape/extent. Complete responses are retained without normalization.

rejected_g2.scope: Separate NL_G2 offset continuation returned status zero but violated analytic circle radii. Successful construction status is insufficient; this experiment is not enabled.

limitations: FilletSrf UI/command, source trimming, joining, attributes/history and disconnected-component choice remain unfinished.
Curved Extend=Yes retains its known large native/SDK extent mismatch. These changes do not qualify the extension policy.

Sampled surface image membership, closest distances and tight bounds do not certify continuous global Rhino agreement or complete NURBS/topology/area protocol parity. Literal SDK closest-point coordinates retain differences above the model epsilon, diagnosed independently as tangential projection differences; SDK fitted-normal effects and query stopping are not distinguished. All raw protocol differences remain in the audit.
A smaller internal construction target is an empirical precision reserve, not a global normal-error bound. Conditioning/resource limits and general throughput remain unqualified.

AddressSanitizer instruments the complete native libraries and C ABI probe; leak detection is disabled. Rust gates run normally. Upstream repo.sh/prog_test, USD, Python-binding and GUI harnesses were not run.
